transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net cancellations audit, my name is Derek.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Derek, my name is Penelope Ward. I cancelled my broadband pre-order four weeks ago within the statutory cooling-off period, but S-Net still hasn't refunded my one-hundred-and-twenty-pound advance equipment deposit, despite three previous agents promising the funds would arrive in my Barclays account within five working days!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect your refund transaction queue. Before we inspect your payment ledger, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 88 Victoria Square, Birmingham, B1 1BD, security PIN 9410, cancellation reference CN-882190.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Penelope, that confirms your account details. What specific date was your cancellation confirmed by our retentions team?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It was formally confirmed on September 15th, and your system sent me an official cancellation receipt letter!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query our central banking reconciliation portal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Penelope. The finance gateway indicates that the refund voucher was generated but held in a suspense verification queue because the card number was recorded with an incorrect expiry year.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why did your system record an incorrect expiry year when S-Net took the one hundred and twenty pounds from the exact same card without any issue?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Automated payment gateways process merchant sales and outbound credits across different clearinghouse protocols.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you correct the expiry year and send my one hundred and twenty pounds back to my card right now?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline cancellation agents do not have administrative access to amend payment card clearing tokens.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me immediately to your banking treasury department who can authorize the refund!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Treasury personnel do not take incoming customer phone calls. You must wait for the monthly audit cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have already waited four weeks! One hundred and twenty pounds is my groceries for two weeks! Why should I wait another month for my own money?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Those are our corporate financial audit regulations for cancelled orders.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Stop reciting corporate regulations and refund my money today!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Listen lady, if you don't like our refund timelines, you can get lost and wait for the cheque in the post.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you just tell a customer to get lost?! Are you completely insane?! Give me your employee ID number right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My employee code is DK-9901.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: DK-9901, written down! I will be taking this recording to the Financial Conduct Authority and Trading Standards today!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Penelope speaking, S-Net has stolen one hundred and twenty pounds of my hard-earned money for four weeks, your staff lied to me three times, and now your representative tells me to get lost on a recorded line! I am shaking with rage, my blood pressure is through the roof, and I will not be abused by this company!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have stated the operational constraints of our refund accounting department.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the formal escalation ticket reference for this complaint?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The complaints reference is CMP-99182-W.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: CMP-99182-W, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A paper cheque for one hundred and twenty pounds will be dispatched by second class post within twenty-eight business days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Twenty-eight business days for a paper cheque?! That is another six weeks!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Paper cheques follow standard commercial banking issuance cycles.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will be initiating a chargeback through Barclays Bank fraud department this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are entitled to pursue chargeback remedies with your merchant bank.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And I will ensure your abusive language is submitted as evidence to your executive directors.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Executive correspondence is handled by our complaints unit in Sunderland.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You are the most unprofessional and offensive company I have ever dealt with.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our corporate policies govern all customer communications.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Your corporate policies apparently include insulting customers and withholding their money.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your feedback on the complaints file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Make sure every word of this call is preserved.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All calls are archived in our compliance database.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have nothing further to say to you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will finalize the cheque issuance request.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just send my money.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was that customer cancellation reference again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of this call, it is CN-882190.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have attached your cancellation reference to the complaints record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will expect my full refund and a written apology.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The complaints department will review the matter in due course.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your cancelled account I can assist with today, Penelope?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, you have been thoroughly abusive.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
